style_en: Japanese TV anime style, clean bold line art, cel shading, calm muted colors, bright even light, Kofun-period ancient Japan. Plain pure white background (#FFFFFF), no floor, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no frame. Full body fully inside the image, filling the height, one single character centered.
avoid_en: text, letters, logo, modern clothes, Chinese-style robes, nudity, blood, wounds, rotting body, skeleton, multiple characters, background scenery

izanagi.desc_en: Izanagi, a dignified young male god of ancient Japan in his mid-20s, black hair tied in mizura loops beside both ears, clean-shaven, white Kofun-period kinu tunic with a dark blue sash and white hakama trousers tied below the knees with red cords, a green magatama bead necklace, a straight sword at the waist

izanami.desc_en: Izanami, a gentle young goddess of ancient Japan in her early 20s, long black hair with the top tied in a loop, white Kofun-period kinu tunic over a long pale vermilion mo skirt, a sheer pale scarf over the shoulders, a green magatama bead necklace, soft kind eyes
